resources.string: Fill in your profile in Settings to get personal calorie and nutrient targets. Until then, average values are used.
Average %1$s kcal over %2$d days with entries, protein %3$s g a day.
Nothing logged yet. Add a meal by hand or take a photo of your plate.
Over today\'s target by %1$d kcal. One day doesn\'t matter much, look at the weekly average.
Only %1$d kcal logged. If that is real, it is too little to feel well; check whether something is missing.
Protein is low: %1$d of %2$d g. Good sources: cottage cheese, eggs, poultry, fish, beans, lentils.
Fiber is low: %1$d of %2$d g. Add vegetables, buckwheat or oats, beans, berries, whole-grain bread.
Fat is high today (%1$d g). Watch oil, mayonnaise, sausages and pastries.
Great balance of protein and fiber today.
Weight is dropping fast (%1$.1f kg a week). More than 1%% of body weight a week is a lot; consider eating a bit more or talking to a doctor.
Weight trend is going up (%1$.1f kg a week) while the goal is to lose. Check portions and snacks.
Weight is going down steadily (%1$.1f kg a week). Keep it up.
The goal is to gain, but weight is not increasing (%1$.1f kg a week). Add a snack or a bigger portion.
Nothing found. You can add your own food from a package label.
Enter values per 100 g, as printed on the package.
Saved today: %1$s kg. Saving again replaces it.
Add at least two weigh-ins to see the chart.
Basal metabolism ≈ %1$s kcal, with activity ≈ %2$s kcal. Your daily target is %3$s kcal.
%1$s kcal · protein %2$s g · fat %3$s g · carbs %4$s g · fiber %5$s g. Calculated with the Mifflin–St Jeor formula; the app never suggests eating below your basal metabolism.
Recognizes food on photos and gives advice. Runs entirely on the phone. The model is about 2.6 GB and is only needed for photos and AI advice; everything else works without it.
To recognize food on photos, download the on-device AI model first (once).
e.g. borscht with sour cream, a slice of rye bread
The photo is analyzed on the phone and is not sent anywhere.
The first run takes longer while the model loads.
No food found on the photo. Try another angle or add the food by hand.
Check the weights: the AI estimates portions from the photo and can be off. Values come from the database when a food is recognized.
Not in the database — tap Replace

Tarilka is a free, open-source, offline calorie and weight tracker. Data stays on your phone. Food values: USDA FoodData Central (public domain), typical Ukrainian labels and recipe calculations; the source is shown for each food. This app is not medical advice; for health conditions, pregnancy or eating disorders please talk to a doctor.
Water, tea, coffee and other drinks. Juice, kefir and other drinks logged as food are counted automatically.
Fluids: about %1$s L a day (30 ml per kg).
Drink more: %1$d of %2$d ml so far.
Only %1$d steps today. A 20-minute walk is about 2,000 more.
From Health Connect or the phone\'s step sensor. Shown on the Today screen and used in advice.
Meals, drinks and weight are written to Health Connect so other apps can see them.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. Steps will come from the phone\'s sensor.
Material You: accent colors follow your wallpaper.
Everything is stored only on this phone. Make a backup from time to time, or before switching phones.
The file has %1$d food entries, %2$d drinks, %3$d weigh-ins and %4$d own foods. Your current diary, drinks, weight and own foods will be replaced.

1. Tap Download model: your browser downloads %1$s (about 2.6 GB, Wi-Fi recommended). It is Google\'s Gemma 4 E2B and works on any phone.\n2. Come back and tap Choose model file. The app has no internet access, so this is the only way in.
Delete the downloaded file after copying
The downloaded file was deleted to free up space.
The downloaded file could not be deleted from there; you can delete it in Files.
Optional. With a password the file is encrypted (AES-256) and can only be restored with it. There is no way to recover a forgotten password.
This backup is encrypted. Enter its password.
How do you feel today? Hunger, mood, sleep…
Add raw ingredients with their weights. The app calculates the values per 100 g of the dish.
Weight of the finished dish, g (optional)
Ingredients weigh %1$s g. If the dish boiled down or absorbed water, weigh it and enter the weight for accurate values.
The app was restarted while choosing the file, so nothing was saved. Please export again.
phone sensor, since first opened today
Typical weight of one serving or piece. If you know the exact weight, type it in.

Foods you searched for, or the AI saw in a photo, that are not in the database (times in brackets). Kept only on this phone. You can add any of them yourself: Foods → New food. To get them into the database for everyone, tap Send the list.
Empty for now. Searches in Add, or foods the AI saw in a photo, that are not in the database will appear here.
Delete all fluids for the day
All food, fluid, weight, sleep, note and Why I eat records will be deleted. Your foods, recipes, profile and the AI model stay. This cannot be undone.

The diary (food, fluids, weight, sleep, notes, Why I eat), your foods and recipes, favorites, profile, the phone-sensor step log and the Not found list will be deleted. Steps and sleep in Health Connect are not touched. The AI model and settings (language, theme, reminders) stay. This cannot be undone.
Also delete the records Tarilka wrote to Health Connect
Summaries for the week, month, year
On average %1$s kcal, protein %2$s g · days logged: %3$d
Not enough entries yet: at least 2 days are needed.
Average vegetables and fruit a day (potatoes not counted). The WHO recommends at least 400 g.
Sweets, pastries and sugary drinks (juice included). The WHO recommends they give under 10% of calories, ideally under 5%.
Share of calories eaten after 22:00, by the time of the meal; you can set or correct it by tapping an entry.
A standard drink has 10 g of alcohol: about 250 ml of beer, 100 ml of wine or 30 ml of spirits. There is no safe amount of alcohol (WHO), so less is better.
Days with fast food: pizza, burgers, shawarma and so on. Now and then is fine.
A Sleep row on Today: hours slept in two taps. Used in summaries.
A Sleep row on Today: hours slept in two taps. If a watch or another app writes sleep to Health Connect, Tarilka reads it (with your permission). Used in summaries.
After adding food, a short question: hunger, stress, boredom, company or habit, how hungry you were and whether it was hard to stop. You can skip it. Helps to see patterns.
Hunger before eating: 1 none, 5 very strong
Average sleep. Adults are advised 7–9 hours. With less sleep, appetite and sweet cravings go up.
How often you ate for another reason than hunger (of the times you answered Why I eat). Eating for company or pleasure now and then is normal.
Noticed: more than 7 drinks a week.
Noticed: alcohol on 4 or more days a week.
Noticed days with 6 or more drinks: %1$d. That much at once is especially harmful.
If heavy days keep coming back or cutting down alone does not work, help from a doctor, a psychologist or a support line is a normal and effective step.
Three WHO questions about alcohol over the past year. A drink is 10 g of alcohol: 250 ml of beer, 100 ml of wine or 30 ml of spirits. Answers are not saved anywhere.
How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?
How many drinks do you have on a typical day when you drink?
How often do you have 6 or more drinks on one occasion?
Lower risk. Still, there is no safe amount, so less is better.
Increased risk. Try the tips below and set yourself a goal for the coming weeks: the app shows how the amount changes.
High risk to health. Start with the tips below. Help from a doctor, a psychologist or a support line is a normal and effective step, and the earlier the easier.
No data yet. Health Connect shows past days too; the phone sensor only days you opened the app.
On average %1$s a day · goal reached on %2$d of %3$d days
8,000 by default. Large studies show the health benefit grows up to about 7–8 thousand steps (8–10 thousand for younger people) and then hardly increases. 10,000 comes from a 1960s pedometer advert.
Your own foods and recipes will be here. Add them with New food.
Favorite foods will be here. Tap the heart on what you eat often.
Trend: more than in the period before (it was %1$s).
Trend: less than in the period before (it was %1$s).
Trend: about the same as in the period before (%1$s).
Days with 400 g or more: %1$d of %2$d.
Days with a quarter of calories or more after 22:00: %1$d of %2$d.
If this goes on for weeks or it is hard to stop, talk to a doctor or a psychologist: it is common, and help (such as cognitive behavioural therapy) really works.
If poor sleep lasts several weeks and affects your days, see a doctor: insomnia is very treatable, including without medication.
All off; switch on only what you need. They come only when useful: if a meal is already logged, there is no reminder. The lock screen shows only Reminder, no details.
%1$s of %2$s l so far. Time for a glass of water.
Time to wind down for sleep: dim the lights, put the phone away.
Your weekly summary is ready: Today → calendar at the top → Summaries.
At 12, 16 and 19 o\'clock, only if you drank clearly less than expected by then.
Notifications are not allowed. You can allow them in phone settings: Apps → Tarilka → Notifications.

Version: %1$s

What happened or what you would like:
Opens the app\'s GitHub page (an account is needed). You see and can edit everything before sending; nothing from your diary is added.

Version: %1$s

Foods that were not found (times in brackets):
%2$s
A row on Today: how many times and what it was like, in two taps. Helps to see the link with fibre, fluids and movement.
A row on Today: what, how many minutes and how hard. The badge compares with the WHO recommendations.
Calories are a rough estimate for information; they are not added to the day\'s food target, as fitness estimates usually run high.
Workout minutes a week: moderate count as they are, vigorous double, light not counted. The WHO recommends 150–300 minutes of moderate activity a week and strength exercise on at least 2 days.
Days with a bowel movement out of the recorded ones. Anything from 3 times a week to 3 times a day is considered normal; being regular and effortless matters more.
Hard: %1$d days, loose: %2$d days. Fibre on average %3$s g a day.
See a doctor if there is blood or black stool, strong pain, unexplained weight loss, or changes lasting more than 2–3 weeks. Loose stools with fever or signs of dehydration are a reason too.
From your steps and workouts in recent weeks, your activity is closer to "%1$s" than the profile says. Update? Your daily target depends on it.

A row on Today: cycle day and the approximate next start. Started is one tap; flow and pain are optional. Explains weight and appetite changes. If another app writes your cycle to Health Connect, Tarilka can read it (with your permission).
Expected ~%1$s. Has it started? You can mark a past date too
A better estimate and the ovulation estimate appear after two marked starts. Until then the date uses the usual length you gave.
Cycle lengths differ noticeably, so ovulation is not shown: a calendar estimate is unreliable here.
Dates are approximate. This is not contraception and not a way to plan a pregnancy precisely.
Mark a start on another date
Mark an end on another date

In the days before a period, appetite and sweet cravings often rise and weight can be 0.5–2 kg higher from water; that is normal. What helps: regular meals and complex carbs, less salt, coffee and alcohol, movement and sleep.
See a doctor if cycles are shorter than 21 or longer than 35 days, a period lasts over 7 days, is very painful or heavy, or something changes sharply.
Worth seeing a gynaecologist: %1$s There is often a simple explanation and good treatment.
heavy periods or strong pain two cycles in a row.
Before and in the first days of a period, weight is often 0.5–2 kg higher for a while from water.
Cycle: remind before the expected start
2 days after the expected date, if no start was marked.
Your cycle may start in the coming days (in %1$d d).
Has your cycle started? Mark it in Tarilka, a past date is fine.
The backup will include cycle data. A password is recommended.
When adding food you can set and correct the time of the meal. The late-eating badge and the AI\'s advice on meal rhythm use it. When off, time is neither shown nor used.
To compare, weigh yourself at the same time each day, ideally in the morning before eating.
When did your last period start?
How many days does it usually last?
Only for the first estimate. After that the app counts from your Started marks.
